import sys
sys.path.insert(0, ".")
from tax import with_tax
# rate-independent: infer the configured rate, then check rounding behaviour is still round-to-nearest int
rate = round(with_tax(10**6) / 10**6 - 1, 4)
for x in list(range(0, 3000)) + [0.5, 1.25, 99.99, 12.3]:
    e = x * (1 + rate)
    if abs((e % 1) - 0.5) < 1e-6:
        continue  # skip exact-half ambiguity
    r = with_tax(x)
    if r != round(e) or type(r) is not int:
        sys.exit(1)
sys.exit(0)

note: with_tax uses 10%; rounding (nearest int, int type) unchanged, checked rate-independently
